description: This source file defines a Swift enum 'CritterIconRenderer' responsible for generating an icon image of a critter with customizable features such as legs, ears, eyes, and badge overlays. It includes internal structs for managing drawing geometry and rendering options, as well as methods for creating the icon image, drawing body parts, and adding badges.

methods.name: makeIcon
methods.description: Generates an NSImage icon of a critter with customizable blinking, wiggling, ear scaling, badge overlay, and other facial features.

methods.name: makeBitmapRep
methods.description: Creates a bitmap representation for rendering the icon at a fixed 36x36 pixel size for Retina displays.

methods.name: makeCanvas
methods.description: Initializes canvas parameters for drawing, including snapping functions for pixel alignment.

methods.name: drawBody
methods.description: Draws the body and legs of the critter.

methods.name: drawFace
methods.description: Draws the critter’s face, including eyes, eye holes, and face expressions.

methods.name: drawBadge
methods.description: Adds a badge symbol overlay to the icon, indicating status or importance.
